name: 3d-pin

frames.best_why: Frame 2 shows the full hover state: card tilted back, site pill above and cyan stem between them.

tagline: A dark card tips back in 3D, sprouting a site label and cyan beam on hover.
summary: A dark link card holding an avatar, a name, a short paragraph and tag pills. Hovering tips it into perspective, fades in a site-name pill above and pulses blue rings behind a thin cyan stem.
appearance: A small near-black rounded card with a barely visible border, holding a violet-to-sky gradient circle, the bold name Aceternity UI, a grey paragraph and three thin outlined tags in a row along the bottom. Hovered, it tilts away under a small dark pill reading aceternity.com, joined by a fine cyan line.
behaviour: At rest the card faces the viewer. On hover it tips back in perspective, shrinks slightly and darkens toward its top edge, a site-name pill fades in above, a cyan pin line and dot appear, and soft blue rings pulse out behind it on a six-second loop. Leaving restores the flat card.
demo_content: Name Aceternity UI, a short paragraph, and tags UI, React and Next.js under an aceternity.com title.
search_phrases: card that tilts back when hovered
link card that reveals a site label
floating card with pulsing blue circles
hover effect for a product card
card that leans away from the cursor
dark card with cyan beam on hover
use_when: A project or profile card should feel interactive and reveal a destination link on hover.
avoid_when: Touch devices or tight layouts: the effect needs hover and a wide overlay area.
customise: The card body comes in as children; title and href feed the hover pill and the link. className and containerClassName restyle it, while the tilt angle, rings and pin are fixed in the source.
weight_why: One card, a single hover transform and three small rings looping.

a11y.note: It is a real link, but the pill, rings and pin appear on hover only, so keyboard focus never reveals them and adds no focus ring.

issues: Hover-only: touch and keyboard users never see the site pill, rings or cyan beam.
The card border is almost invisible against the black stage until hovered.
polish_why: Crisp perspective tilt and pin detail, but the faint border and hover-only reveal are misses.
